split.outer_split: M25 train_test_split, stratify=three-class Target, shuffle=True. The binary label is applied after the split.
split.inner_cv: RepeatedStratifiedKFold on the training partition, stratified on the binary indicator. Folds do not preserve the Enrolled versus Graduate mix inside Not Dropout.
split.oof: One StratifiedKFold pass on the training partition, stratified on the binary indicator.
split.target_rule: Dropout is coded 1. Enrolled and Graduate are coded 0 and called Not Dropout.
split.not_dropout_note: Not Dropout is an observed grouping of UCI records labeled Enrolled or Graduate at the end of the normal course duration. It is not proof of future retention.
